title: Use Bag Out Control System to close destinations and exchange occupied totes/chutes
summary: Run a Bag Out action in the OptiSweep Bag Out Control system so that destinations are closed and totes/chutes containing parcels are exchanged. The control supports system-wide bag out and also bag out scoped by sorter leg. For manual bag out, a cancel bag out option is available to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process.
when_to_use: Use when you need to end a sort cycle by closing destinations and exchanging totes/chutes that contain parcels, using the Bag Out Control system behavior described in the source.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the Bag Out action (system-wide or by sorter leg) using the Bag Out Control system UI/control shown in the source.
safety_notes: If performing a manual bag out, use the cancel bag out capability only for exchange tasks that are not in process; exchange tasks that are already in process must still finish.
access_or_tools_needed: Bag out control system UI/control (as shown in the source training segment)

visual_references.description: Training frame showing the Bag Out Control system behavior: system bag out closes all destinations and exchanges totes/chutes with parcels; option to bag out by leg of the sorter; manual bag out cancel bag out behavior; pre bag out exchanges lowest 25% of destinations per leg.

steps.title: Open the Bag Out control system screen/control
steps.purpose: Access the Bag Out Control system options needed to run a system-wide or sorter-leg-scoped bag out.
steps.instruction: Open the Bag Out control system UI/control shown in the source segment.
steps.expected_result: The Bag Out control system options are visible, including system bag out and the ability to choose bag out by leg of the sorter (and manual bag out options such as cancel bag out, if applicable).
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Bag Out control system panel/options (system bag out and bag out by leg of the sorter) on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: The Bag Out control system options are not visible or you cannot access the bag out controls needed to start the action.

actions.label: Open Bag Out control system
actions.exact_action: Open the bag out control system screen/control described in the training segment.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You have your bag out control system.”

steps.title: Select the system bag out option
steps.purpose: Run a system-wide bag out that closes all destinations and exchanges totes/chutes containing parcels.
steps.instruction: Select the system bag out option (the full-system option, not the sorter-leg-specific option).
steps.expected_result: The selected bag out scope is system-wide (not limited to a single sorter leg).
steps.healthy_condition: The Bag Out control system indicates the system-wide bag out selection is active.
steps.failure_condition: A sorter-leg-specific scope is selected when you intended system-wide bag out.

actions.label: Choose system bag out
actions.exact_action: Select the system bag out option (not a sorter-leg-specific option).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “System bag out will close all destinations and exchange all totes with parcels in them.”

steps.title: Confirm the intended system-wide behavior (close all destinations; exchange totes/chutes with parcels)
steps.purpose: Verify the bag out action you are about to run matches the expected system-wide behavior.
steps.instruction: Confirm that the Bag Out control system indicates system bag out will close all destinations and exchange totes/chutes with parcels in them.
steps.expected_result: The control’s described behavior matches: destinations are closed and totes/chutes containing parcels are exchanged.
steps.healthy_condition: The Bag Out control system panel text/labels reflect “close all destinations” and “exchange … with parcels in them” for system bag out.
steps.failure_condition: The control indicates a different behavior than closing all destinations and exchanging totes/chutes with parcels.

actions.label: Verify system-wide behavior
actions.exact_action: Confirm the intended behavior: system bag out will close all destinations and exchange totes/chutes with parcels in them.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the observed behavior does not match the source-described outcomes (destinations not closing and/or parcels not being exchanged).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Bag out will close all destinations and exchange shoots with parcels in them.” / “System bag out will close all destinations and exchange all totes with parcels in them.”

steps.title: If limiting scope, select bag out by leg of the sorter
steps.purpose: Run bag out for a specific sorter leg instead of the full system.
steps.instruction: If the operation should be limited, select the bag out by leg of the sorter option.
steps.expected_result: The bag out scope is set to a sorter-leg level rather than system-wide.
steps.healthy_condition: The Bag Out control system indicates bag out by leg of the sorter is selected.
steps.failure_condition: Sorter-leg-specific bag out is not selected when you intend to limit scope.

actions.label: Choose bag out by sorter leg
actions.exact_action: Select the bag out by leg of the sorter option (as described by the source).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “A user could also choose to bag out by leg of the sorter.” / “user can also choose a bag out by leg of the sorter.”

steps.title: If performing manual bag out, use cancel bag out only for exchanges not in process
steps.purpose: Prevent canceling exchange tasks that are already in process during manual bag out.
steps.instruction: If you are performing a manual bag out and need to cancel, use cancel bag out only to cancel exchange tasks that are not in process; do not cancel tasks that are already in an exchange.
steps.expected_result: Only exchange tasks not currently in process are canceled; any exchange task already in process continues to completion.
steps.healthy_condition: Cancel bag out does not interrupt an exchange task that is already in process.
steps.failure_condition: Cancel bag out cancels an exchange task that is already in process (it should still finish).

actions.label: Cancel bag out (manual only)
actions.exact_action: Use the cancelled bag out capability only as allowed by the source (cancel any exchange task that is not in process).

stop_or_escalate_if: If performing a manual bag out, ensure you use the cancel bag out capability only as allowed by the source (cancel only exchange tasks not in process).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancelled bag out. This will cancel any exchange chest that is not in process.” / “You can cancel the bag out, but it has to be not in the exchange. So like if it's in an exchange, it has to come. That one still has to finish.”

success_criteria: Destinations are closed after the bag out action.
Totes/chutes containing parcels are exchanged after the bag out action.
If bag out is scoped by sorter leg, the scope matches the selected sorter leg (not system-wide).
If manual bag out cancel is used, only exchange tasks not in process are canceled; in-process exchange tasks still finish.
healthy_conditions: Bag out behavior matches the control’s described outcomes: close all destinations and exchange totes/chutes with parcels in them (system bag out) or the selected sorter leg (leg-scoped bag out).
failure_conditions: Destinations do not close as expected.
Parcels are not exchanged (totes/chutes with parcels are not exchanged).
Manual cancel bag out cancels an exchange task that is already in process.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the observed behavior does not match the source-described outcomes (destinations not closing and/or parcels not being exchanged).
